name: Mariel multimodal rail station data center virtualization project

notes: Academic repository entry describes development of a virtualization system for the railway data center at the Mariel multimodal station in Artemisa. No MW/campus-scale details found.

name: University of Camaguey data center
developer: Universidad de Camaguey Ignacio Agramonte Loynaz
notes: Search results identify a data-center administrator for the University of Camaguey and a university post referencing work involving ETECSA's data center. Treated as an institutional data center, not a commercial colocation/hyperscale project.

name: University of Ciego de Avila data center systems update
developer: Universidad de Ciego de Avila Maximo Gomez Baez
notes: Social-media search result references work in the university data center updating systems. No independent source, capacity, or commercial operator evidence found.

name: University of Granma primary and secondary data centers
notes: Academic/security and university web-services documents describe a primary data center at Campus 2 plus secondary nodes at larger University of Granma sites. Institutional facility; no commercial colocation/hyperscale evidence found.

name: University of Holguin data center solar backup project
notes: Local news reports installation of a backup photovoltaic system to protect the University of Holguin data center and keep institutional digital services operating through outages.

name: Cayo Digital technology hub
developer: Cuba-Russia / BRICS Plus and Eurasian Economic Union proposal
notes: Planned technology hub/cluster for up to 15,000 IT specialists and students in Isla de la Juventud. Sources mention offices, labs, industrial plants, and digital services, but no dedicated data-center building or MW capacity was confirmed.

name: ETECSA Las Tunas data center region
developer: Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Cuba S.A. (ETECSA)
notes: ETECSA official VPS page lists Las Tunas as one of three available data-center regions for virtual-server deployment. Local reporting says ETECSA Las Tunas planned 2025 improvements to cooling and energy support for its data center.

name: University of Matanzas data center photovoltaic electrical backup project
notes: Conference paper describes the University of Matanzas data center and proposes/contextualizes photovoltaic electrical backup for continuity of research, education, administration, and digital services.
